explanation_short: KNN achieved the highest R² score (0.83014) and lowest MSE (0.011901) when using 9 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low). RF achieved the best overall performance with 11 features (R²=0.785537, MSE=0.015026).
explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis shows the best feature subset for each model. For KNN, the optimal subset consists of 9 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low), yielding an R² of 0.83014 and an MSE of 0.011901. For RF, the best performance is achieved with all 11 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low -> ORP_Mid -> Sucrose_Degradation), resulting in an R² of 0.785537 and an MSE of 0.015026. For SVM, the optimal subset is 4 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS), achieving R²=0.779437 and MSE=0.015453. XGBoost performs best with 4 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS), with R²=0.768407 and MSE=0.016226.
